asunto.urgencia+erratas: WARNING: Your password expires TODAY - immediate action required

entradilla.base: As part of the {{empresa}} credential policy, your password reaches the end of its 90-day cycle on {{fechaCaducidad}}.
entradilla.urgencia: Your {{empresa}} account password expires in {{dias}} days. To keep access to email, Teams and shared files, you need to renew it before then.
entradilla.urgencia+erratas: Your email password EXPIRES TODAY. If you do not update it immediately you will lose access to your account and all your files.

detalle.base: You can renew it from the usual portal or from the link below. If you already changed it this week, ignore this message: the notice is generated two days in advance.
detalle.urgencia: It takes less than a minute and you may reuse a password you already remember, as long as it meets the organisation's policy.
detalle.urgencia+erratas: This is an automatic message from the mail server. Do not ignore this notice.

urgencia.base: Remember that the new password must also be updated on your work phone so that email keeps syncing.
urgencia.urgencia: If the password expires, you will need to contact support to restore access manually.
urgencia.urgencia+erratas: Your account will be SUSPENDED within the next hours if you do not complete the verification.
